title: P1 hello: request
description: The worker reports its kind, implementation, labels, capacity and protocol versions; a toolhost also its plugins, placement and the fingerprint of the live tools/list; a channel its driver capabilities. Labels can only narrow those recorded at enroll; a mismatch with the enroll record moves the worker to blocked (DEP-2, INJ-2). The request has no tenant: it is taken from the credentials (TEN-2, TEN-4). It can be repeated.

implementation.description: Name and version of the worker implementation.

labels.description: Worker labels; only a narrowing of those recorded at enroll.

capacity.description: Worker capacity; for a runtime with model_attribution: per_profile it equals 1 (RT-3).

protocol_versions.description: Major P1 versions that the worker knows; the core accepts the current and the previous one (LCY-7).

tools_fingerprint.description: Only a toolhost: the fingerprint of the live tools/list per spec/hashing.md.

ai_disclosure.description: native or first_contact; a driver without it does not pass apply (DLV-12).

provenance.description: How the channel passes the dataorigin mark (DLV-13).

membership_assurance.description: enforced if the driver sees members joining a group chat (DLV-7).

stores_content.description: What tenant content the channel keeps itself: none (nothing: attachments go straight to C1 through file.put, there is no cache), attachments, cache. For a channel with none the core itself closes the E1 erasure step with the outcome not_applicable with basis declared_none, without a work item (RET-7). By default none.
